title: Variant family spec
description: A declarative record of one variant family for Scripts/art/variantpipe.py -- what the base character was, which silhouette axis the family spends, what every variant holds constant, and per-variant what was asked for. See .claude/skills/variants/SKILL.md for the workflow this codifies, and docs/backlog/task-081-codify-variant-family-pipeline.md for why. Families backfilled from before this schema existed (their generation predates any manifest) fill 'base' and per-variant 'edit_description'/'silhouette_target' with null rather than a guess -- see each family's family.json 'note' field for what is actually known.

family.description: Matches the directory name under RawArt/Renders/<family>/ and docs/data/art/families/<family>/.

note.description: Free text for anything a field can't say -- e.g. that this family predates manifest tracking.

character_id.description: PixelLab character UUID this family's states were built from. get_character confirms it; null if not recorded.

canvas_size.description: The confirmed RETURNED canvas in px (not the requested 'size' -- see SKILL.md's size-vs-canvas trap). Used by judge to reject a variant whose canvas doesn't match.

name.description: aspect | topology | interior | mixed -- see SKILL.md's 'order of axes'.

description.description: What this family actually varies, in one sentence.

constant.description: What every variant in the family holds constant (SKILL.md step 2's variance table).

forge.description: Optional defaults for Scripts/art/forge.py, the local page that generates and judges this family. Every field is optional and a CLI flag overrides it; a family with no forge block still works, it just cannot ship without --atlas/--prefix.

atlas.description: Composite request id approved variants ship into, e.g. team-units.

prefix.description: Atlas prefix a variant's slug is appended to, e.g. 'archer-'. Must match the block this family already occupies, or forged variants start a second block.

tail.description: Constant clauses appended to every edit_description, overriding forge.py's TAIL default. These are the clauses each variant's prompt currently repeats verbatim -- head/legs legibility and the palette/no-glow rule.

slug.description: Matches the variant's folder name under raw/.

silhouette_target.description: The target stated in plain geometric terms when the variant was queued (SKILL.md step 3). A bare number is read as an aspect target by judge's undershoot check; a string is a target judge cannot check numerically and is informational only. null for a variant whose original target was never recorded.

edit_description.description: The exact prompt text sent to create_character_state/create_character. null if not recorded (pre-dates this schema) -- plan reconstructs kwargs from this when the variant has not yet been generated.

source.description: 'generated' = queue this through plan/fetch. 'legacy' = already on disk from before this pipeline existed; plan skips it.
